name: Sennou Oujo
source:
Leon the Spellmaker was determined to seduce the empress away from the lord in power.
He crafted a black magic that would brainwash Lady Lynette into becoming his own wife.
Along the way there would be many obstacles: Lynette's personal knight Noel; her castle spellmaker Violeta; a nun who roams the castle, Sister Nina...
By corrupting the women around her Leon could get close to the empress... That was his mission. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE126299.html]DLsite English[/url]]
